name: Dan
source:
Gang # 2
Color: Orange
Sin: Envy

The kind of guy who feels familiar at first glance. Warm, open, and almost country sweet, as if he had wandered into gangster life by accident. In reality, he’s one of Ray’s key men. A soft half-smile and an attentive look make him easy to trust. Dan’s the first to offer help, the first to throw you a friendly word, never pushing or intimidating. Even the hardest moments feel a little lighter around him. But is that simplicity hiding something else?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314300/]Steam[/url]]
